name: OpenSCAD
tested: not yet run on a device
why: OpenSCAD finds its libraries, fonts, color schemes and shaders in ../Resources next to its executable (the Mac bundle's Contents/Resources); on iOS the executable sits at the top of the app, beside MacResources/; its edge shader divides a vec3 by an int, which desktop GLSL 1.20 converts and OpenGL ES's GLSL (under gl4es) rejects, leaving the model undrawn; with edges off the same shader takes smoothstep(0, 0, x), which a Mac GPU answers and OpenGL ES turns into NaN, so meshes came out invisible

resource_patches.replace:
vec3 d = fwidth(vBC);
  if (max(d.x, max(d.y, d.z)) == 0.0) return 1.0; // smoothstep(0, 0, x) is 0/0 on OpenGL ES
